data.name: Mahfooz
data.gender_notes: Mahfooz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is protected or secured. Derived from the Arabic word 'mahfuza' meaning to protect or preserve. The name Mahfooz carries the meaning “Protected, Secure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahfooz usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, secure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of Allah's protection and security around the bearer. It is a reminder that Allah is always with us, watching over us, and keeping us safe.
data.etymology: Mahfooz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected, Secure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahfooz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: محفوظ
in_arabic.meaning: المحفوظ من الله، من يحفظه الله من كل سوء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم المحفوظ مشتق من الفعل حفظ، ويعني الشخص الذي يحفظه الله من كل سوء وشر، وهو اسم يدل على الحفظ والرعاية الإلهية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والذين هم على صلاتهم يحافظون'، ويعتبر اسم محفوظ من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: محفوظ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی حفاظت میں، محفوظ شدہ، بچایا ہوا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محفوظ عربی زبان کی root حفظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محفوظ کرنا یا حفاظت کرنا، یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اللہ کی حفاظت میں ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص محفوظ ہے من تمام خطرات و مصائب، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا استعمال جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں رواج پزیر ہے.

in_hindi.name: महफूज
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की सुरक्षा में, सुरक्षित, संरक्षित
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम महफूज अरबी भाषा के मूल حفظ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षित करना या संरक्षित करना, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो भगवान की सुरक्षा में है, और इसका अर्थ है कि वह व्यक्ति सभी खतरों और विपत्तियों से सुरक्षित है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है.

in_pashto.name: محفوظ
in_pashto.meaning: د الله په حفاظت کې، خوندي، ژغورلی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د محفوظ نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښو حفظ څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د خوندي کولو يا حفاظت کولو معنی لري، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کيږي چې د الله په حفاظت کې وي، او د دې مطلب دا دی چې هغه څوک د ټولو خطرونو او پېښو څخه خوندي دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دوديزو کې مهم ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Mahfooz
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mahfooz is derived from the Arabic root 'حفظ' (hafaza), which means to protect or preserve, it is used for a person who is under God's protection, implying safety from all evils and dangers, the name has a strong Quranic background and historical significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing divine protection and care, and is widely used across Muslim cultures globally.

data.cultural_impact: "Mahfooz" represents an individual who is cherished and safeguarded, both physically and metaphorically. It is a name that emphasizes the importance of family and community in maintaining the well-being and security of its members. In Islamic culture, a child with this name is loved and cared for by their community, who strive to shield them from harm and nurture their growth into virtuous and compassionate beings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Mahfooz" carries the deeper meaning of being preserved by God, protected in His custody. It is a reminder that nothing happens by mere chance and that every moment in life holds a divine purpose. The spiritual significance of this name encourages individuals to trust in God's plan and to seek His protection and guidance at all times. Embracing this sanctified name serves as a powerful reminder to stay steadfast along the righteous path, knowing that the Almighty is ever watchful and protective.
